questions.text: 7] Tips & Tricks 48 WNohler synthesised the first organic compound urea in the laboratory. 4s The number of optical isomers of a compound depends on its structure and number of asymmetric carbon atoms present in its molecule. 45 Stereoisomers that are not mirror images of each other are called diastereomers. 4s Order of priority for both_asymmetric carbon atoms using sequence rules is -OH > - COOH > -CH(OH)COOH > -H 45 The nitration and sulphonation of alkanes involve free radicals. 48 Carbenes undergo insertion reactions. 45 Alkanes usually undergo free radical ‘substitution when hydrogen is replaced by a halogen. It is catalysed by benzoyl peroxide (CsHsCOO)p. 4s The polymerisation of alkenes is free radical addition reaction. 45 Allyl free radical (CH2 = CH - CH) is more stable than n-propyl free radical (CH3CH2CH;). 48 The stability of free radicals is explained on the basis of hyperconjugation or conjugation. 45 Propene is more reactive than ethene towards electrophilic addition reaction due to the formation of more stable 2° carbocation. 4 The reactivity of alkyl halides in SN' is 3°> 2°>1°>methyl while SN’ is methyl > 1°> 2°> 3°. 4 Polar solvents favour SN’ while non polar solvents favour SN’ reactions. 45 Dipole moment of CHC/; is less than that of CH2Ch. This is because in CH>C/, all bond moments reinforce each other while in CHC/; the bond moment of one of the C/ opposes the net moment of the other two. 4 Low concentration of nucleophiles favour SN' while high concentration favour SN’. 4 In SN' the attack of the nucleophile may be from either side and so recimization takes place. However, in SN? the attack of the nucleophile takes place from back side. So it leads to inversion of configuration. 4s Hunsdieker reaction proceeds via free radical mechanism. 45 Propene reacts with chlorine at 673 K to form allyl chloride and the intermediate is allyl free radical. KEY: A Passage - 4 The rule governing the transition from ionic to covalent bonding is called Fajan’s rule. By this rule the degree of covalency of molecules are known. When an anion and cation approach each other then the electron cloud of anion is not only attracted by the nucleus, but also by the charge on cation. At the same time the cation also tends to repel, the positively charged nucleus of anions. The combined effect of these two forces is that electron cloud of anion is elongated towards the cation. This ability of cation to polarize anion is known polarization power of cation. The higher is the polarization power of cation higher is the covalent character of the molecule. questions.text: 7 Tips & Tricks 45 Alkyl nitrites are the esters of nitrous acid. 48 Nitroparaffins are used as solvents for oils, fats, resins, esters, rubbers and cellulose etc. nitromethane is used as high power fuel in racing automobiles. 48 Nitrobenzene is good solvent in friedel crafts reaction because it dissolves A/C/; 48 All amines have basic properties. The basic property, that is, the tendency of primary, secondary and tertiary amines to bind a proton, is due to the unshared pair of electrons on the nitrogen. When.a proton is bound, positive ion is formed and originally electrically neutral amine takes on the charge of the proton. When ions are formed in this way, they are called-onium.ions. The ion formed in case of amines are substituted ammonium ions. The hydronium ion, H30° is also the onium ion, which belongs to the class of oxonium ions. 45 Some derivatives of ammonia arranged in order of deecreasing basicity are (CH3),N°OH, (CH3),.NH, CH3NH2, (CH3)3N, NHs, CeHsNH>2, CsHsNHCH3, CeHsNH2, (CsHs)2NH, CH3CONH). 45 In water the basicity follows the order : Primary < Tertiary < Secondary amine, with reference to hydronium ion, H30*. In this case solvation factor and steric effect alter, to some extent, the order of basicity because of inductive effect alone. 45 In a non-polar solvent such as benzene, using trichloroacetic acid as the reference acid, the basicity follows the order Tertiary < Secondary < Primary amines. The solvation factor is absent but steric effect upsets the inductive effect of alkyl groups. 45 Carylamine test is specific for primary amines.
